get_jax_activation_by_name: get a JAX activation function by name such as bentid, softsign, gelu, or gelu_exact
get_transformed_activations_jax: get transformed activation functions for a list of activation names using JAX tensors
lookup_activation_jnp: lookup an activation function from jax.numpy by its attribute name
lookup_activation_jax_nn: lookup an activation function from jax.nn by its attribute name
lookup_activation_jax_lax: lookup an activation function from jax.lax by its attribute name
